description.value: The study examined environmental sound naming in patients with corticobasal degeneration, progressive supranuclear palsy, Alzheimer disease, frontotemporal dementia, and controls, and investigated voxel-based morphometry correlates of naming sounds of manipulable objects.

spans.text: Therefore, the purpose of this study was to examine naming of environmental sounds in patients with CBD and PSP.

value: We hypothesized that CBD/PSP patients would exhibit impaired naming performance compared with controls, but the impairment would be most apparent when naming sounds associated with actions.

spans.text: We hypothesized that patients with CBD/PSP would have deficits in naming sounds of objects but, in particular, naming sounds of manipulable objects because of the motor deficits.
